text: [1] God! Save me by your name; defend me by your might!
God! Hear my prayer; listen to the words of my mouth!
The proud have come up against me; violent people want me dead. They pay no attention to God. Selah
But look here: God is my helper; my Lord sustains my life.
He will bring disaster on my opponents. By your faithfulness, God, destroy them!
I will sacrifice to you freely; I will give thanks to your name, LORD, because it’s so good,
and because God has delivered me from every distress. My eyes have seen my enemies’ defeat. [2]
